On Apr 19, 2013 12:35 PM, "Guo, Jason" <jaso...@bankofamerica.com> wrote:

Hi, Dr. Guha,

 

I’m using Rhipe recently to produce thousands of pdfs in parallel. So, by using pdf('tmp/myfilename.pdf') in map phase, and setting copyFiles=TRUE in rhmr, I’m able to get all the pdfs in ofolder. But since there are thousands of such pdfs, I’d like to group them in different subfolders. But when I do this,

 

 

map <- expression({ lapply(seq_along(map.values),

    function(r) {

        v <- map.values[[r]]

        #suppose I have two elements in map.key

        k1 <- map.keys[[r]][1]

        k2 <- map.keys[[r]][2]

        pdf(paste('tmp/',k1,'/',k2,'.pdf',sep=''))

        plot(v$forecast,v$Actual)

        dev.off()

    })

})

 

 

Rhipe would not copy any of the files created under tmp/k1 to ofolder. Is there a way that I can get it done successfully? If not, I think it would be very convenient that Rhipe can copy all the side effect files from both tmp/ and all its sub folders to output directory, and preserve the directory structure that user designed in tmp/.

 

 

Thanks.

 

 

Jason Guo

parts:
Download: https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/unstable/code/Rhipe_0.73.1.tar.gz
(not yet in release)

From the commit log

Log Message:
  -----------
  1. rhmkdir added
2. rhcp and rhmv use rJava and now there should be no reference to hadoop binary
3. copyFile=FALSE (not F) in rhmr
4. Two modifications for copyFiles (in rhoptions)
   - rhipe_copy_excludes [ default="(.*/Rtmp.*)" ], the Java regex that excludes files to be copied
   - rhipe_copyfile_folder [default="job output_folder/_outputs/" ]: the destination in the output folder where files will be copied
5. file.types.remove.regex updated for 4. Note if rhipe_copyfile_folder is modified then this( file.types.remove.regex )  has to be too.

Example:

a <- rhwatch(
       setup=expression(map={
         plot.folders <- sprintf("tmp/%s",Sys.getenv("mapred.task.id"))
         ## Folder needs to be created
         dir.create(plot.folders,showWarnings=FALSE)
       }),
       map   = rhmap({
         pdf(sprintf("%s/%s.pdf",plot.folders,k))
         plot(runif(k))
         dev.off()
       }),
       input = c(10,5),
       read  = FALSE,
       copy  = TRUE)
rhls(a)
